name: repentogxm
author: 0xl0cal
description: repentogxm is an experimental static-recompilation port of The Binding of Isaac: Repentance to the PlayStation Vita. The PC executable is translated ahead of time into C and compiled for the Vita's ARM CPU. There is no emulator. This repository contains no game code, resources or binaries; you supply your own PC copy. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Edmund McMillen, Nicalis, Valve, Sony, or the maintainers of any dependency named below.
